free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports further investigation due to a PI-RADS 5 lesion and a rapid PSA velocity of 14.63 ng/mL/yr, which overrides the reassuring normal DRE and the prior positive biopsy. The high-risk imaging finding (PI-RADS 5) and the significant PSA rise from 55.6 ng/mL to 70.0 ng/mL provide strong pathological drivers for sampling.
